-- transcoding off, GET /Items/{itemId}
SELECT u.id::text, u.name, u.is_admin, u.last_login_at, u.configuration, u.track_preferences FROM devices d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.token = $1
SELECT id::text, name, kind FROM libraries WHERE id = $1::uuid AND gone_at IS NULL
SELECT i.id::text, i.dto, COALESCE(d.played, false), COALESCE(d.favorite, false), COALESCE(d.play_count, 0), COALESCE(d.position_ticks, 0), i.run_time_ticks, d.last_played_at, c.keys FROM shown_items i LEFT JOIN user_item_data d ON d.item_id = i.id AND d.user_id = $2::uuid LEFT JOIN media_sources m ON m.id = i.id LEFT JOIN chapter_images c ON c.source_id = m.id AND c.state = 'done' AND c.etag = m.object_etag AND (SELECT chapter_images FROM libraries WHERE id = i.library_id) WHERE i.id = ANY($1::uuid[])
SELECT COALESCE(dto->'MediaSources', '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(replace(m.id::text, '-', ''), (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.streams) s WHERE s->>'Type' = 'Audio')) FROM media_sources m WHERE m.item_id = shown_items.id), '{}'::jsonb) FROM shown_items WHERE id = $1::uuid
-- transcoding off, GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}
SELECT u.id::text, u.name, u.is_admin, u.last_login_at, u.configuration, u.track_preferences FROM devices d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.token = $1
SELECT id::text, name, kind FROM libraries WHERE id = $1::uuid AND gone_at IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(dto->'MediaSources', '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(replace(m.id::text, '-', ''), (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.streams) s WHERE s->>'Type' = 'Audio')) FROM media_sources m WHERE m.item_id = shown_items.id), '{}'::jsonb) FROM shown_items WHERE id = $1::uuid

-- transcoding off, POST PlaybackInfo

-- transcoding on, GET /Items/{itemId}
SELECT u.id::text, u.name, u.is_admin, u.last_login_at, u.configuration, u.track_preferences FROM devices d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.token = $1
SELECT id::text, name, kind FROM libraries WHERE id = $1::uuid AND gone_at IS NULL
SELECT i.id::text, i.dto, COALESCE(d.played, false), COALESCE(d.favorite, false), COALESCE(d.play_count, 0), COALESCE(d.position_ticks, 0), i.run_time_ticks, d.last_played_at, c.keys FROM shown_items i LEFT JOIN user_item_data d ON d.item_id = i.id AND d.user_id = $2::uuid LEFT JOIN media_sources m ON m.id = i.id LEFT JOIN chapter_images c ON c.source_id = m.id AND c.state = 'done' AND c.etag = m.object_etag AND (SELECT chapter_images FROM libraries WHERE id = i.library_id) WHERE i.id = ANY($1::uuid[])
SELECT COALESCE(dto->'MediaSources', '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(replace(m.id::text, '-', ''), (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.streams) s WHERE s->>'Type' = 'Audio')) FROM media_sources m WHERE m.item_id = shown_items.id), '{}'::jsonb) FROM shown_items WHERE id = $1::uuid
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND (slots > 0 OR cores > 0) AND output_version = $2 AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)) AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT store) FROM transcode_nodes WHERE seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1) AND NOT (store = '' AND roles = 'worker')) <= 1
-- transcoding on, GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}
SELECT u.id::text, u.name, u.is_admin, u.last_login_at, u.configuration, u.track_preferences FROM devices d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.token = $1

-- transcoding on, GET PlaybackInfo
SELECT u.id::text, u.name, u.is_admin, u.last_login_at, u.configuration, u.track_preferences FROM devices d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.token = $1
SELECT COALESCE(dto->'MediaSources', '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(replace(m.id::text, '-', ''), (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.streams) s WHERE s->>'Type' = 'Audio')) FROM media_sources m WHERE m.item_id = shown_items.id), '{}'::jsonb) FROM shown_items WHERE id = $1::uuid
SELECT m.id::text, m.store_key, m.object_etag, m.container, l.media_store_uri, l.asset_store_uri, m.size, COALESCE(i.run_time_ticks, 0), m.streams, CASE WHEN $3 THEN m.keyframes END, CASE WHEN $3 THEN COALESCE(m.video_end, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM media_sources m JOIN shown_items i ON i.id = m.item_id JOIN libraries l ON l.id = i.library_id WHERE m.item_id = $1::uuid AND ($2 = '' OR m.id = NULLIF($2, '')::uuid) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND (slots > 0 OR cores > 0) AND output_version = $2 AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)) AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT store) FROM transcode_nodes WHERE seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1) AND NOT (store = '' AND roles = 'worker')) <= 1
SELECT m.id::text, m.store_key, m.object_etag, m.container, l.media_store_uri, l.asset_store_uri, m.size, COALESCE(i.run_time_ticks, 0), m.streams, CASE WHEN $3 THEN m.keyframes END, CASE WHEN $3 THEN COALESCE(m.video_end, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM media_sources m JOIN shown_items i ON i.id = m.item_id JOIN libraries l ON l.id = i.library_id WHERE m.item_id = $1::uuid AND ($2 = '' OR m.id = NULLIF($2, '')::uuid) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcode_nodes WHERE roles ~ '(^|,)worker(,|$)' AND (slots > 0 OR cores > 0) AND output_version = $2 AND seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)) AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT store) FROM transcode_nodes WHERE seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1) AND NOT (store = '' AND roles = 'worker')) <= 1
SELECT m.id::text, m.store_key, m.object_etag, m.container, l.media_store_uri, l.asset_store_uri, m.size, COALESCE(i.run_time_ticks, 0), m.streams, CASE WHEN $3 THEN m.keyframes END, CASE WHEN $3 THEN COALESCE(m.video_end, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM media_sources m JOIN shown_items i ON i.id = m.item_id JOIN libraries l ON l.id = i.library_id WHERE m.item_id = $1::uuid AND ($2 = '' OR m.id = NULLIF($2, '')::uuid) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
